evals.prompt: The Insights placement export has two pages, but I only downloaded one. Some placements have a blank purchase count. Please give me total purchases and ROAS.
required_behaviors: Marks the export partial and blank cells unavailable
Requests remaining pages and eligible unbroken totals
Uses matching purchase action and spend/value definitions
forbidden_behaviors: Reports a partial total as complete

evals.prompt: Meta click-attributed store purchases changed sharply after a reporting update, while POS totals stayed stable. Should I combine the old and new reports?
required_behaviors: Checks if the click and engage-through definitions changed
Keeps comparable definitions and reporting windows
forbidden_behaviors: Treats Meta credit as incremental sales
Assumes a parameter forces older report behavior
